data_fields.name: respawn_max_s
data_fields.donor_constant: max_respawn_delay per spawn row (DB); drawn delay is in [min, max)

data_fields.name: presence_inner_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: 13 (a player within 13 tiles always counts as seeing the spot)

data_fields.name: presence_outer_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: 17 (beyond 17 tiles never counts; 13 to 17 uses a second test, partly read)

best_idea: Refill each empty spawn slot on its own timer after its mob has been gone for a linger plus a random delay, and hold the refill while any player can see the chosen tile.
decision_why: The slot-based population cap and the not-in-view hold are the parts to take; the screen-based view test cannot run on the server, since the camera is client-only, so Frankendom needs a per-zone server distance rule and a retry cap instead.
acceptance: A server test with a two-slot zone kills one mob and asserts the slot stays empty for the linger plus a delay in [min, max) seconds; the refill is never within the zone's no-spawn distance of a hero; with a hero on the chosen tile the placement retries every 3 s and, after the retry cap, the mob is placed at the home tile.
